svg.text: WHAT IS PUBLIC RECORD, AND WHAT THIS DRAWING INVENTS

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Raven Rock’s interior is CLASSIFIED. No public floor plan exists, and since 2007 US DoD policy has forbidden making "any photograph, sketch, picture, drawing, map or graphical representation" of the complex (references/manifest.yaml REF-015).

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: This sheet is an openly-labelled imaginative interpretation of a public landmark, drawn for a Minecraft build. It is NOT a map of the real facility, contains no classified information, and must never be presented as one.

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: FROM THE PUBLIC RECORD (setting and concept only) — the mountain is Catoctin greenstone / metabasalt, not granite [VERIFIED REF-003]; the caverns were blasted out and roughly half a million cubic yards hauled away, 1951–53 [VERIFIED REF-004];

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: the continuity-of-government / ANMCC command mission [VERIFIED REF-010] and the 114th Signal Bn / DISA signals tenancy [VERIFIED REF-011]; freestanding multi-story buildings standing clear of the cavern walls on giant shock-isolation springs [INFERENCE REF-005];

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: several hillside tunnel portals, commonly said to be four, with tunnels curving gently to blunt a blast wave [INFERENCE REF-007 / REF-017]; self-sufficiency — on-site power, ventilation and underground reservoirs [INFERENCE REF-009].

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: INVENTED FOR THIS BUILD [CREATIVE] — every coordinate, elevation and dimension on this sheet: all cavern outlines and heights, all building footprints, floor counts and positions, all tunnel and corridor routes, the portal positions, the blast-vestibule

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: placements, the rotunda, the reservoir sizes and positions, and the RR-Z5 vertical shaft (a deliberate, droppable liberty). The FOUR-building count is a design choice between contested public claims of three and five [REF-006]. The ~20-block burial depth is a

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: build convention, not a survey: the real complex is popularly said to sit ~650 ft below the summit [INFERENCE REF-008], which at this world’s scale (1 block ≈ 2 ft) would be ~325 blocks down and off the envelope entirely.
